# Synthetic test fixtures

`synthetic_loan_month_panel.csv` is a hand-authored, fictional fixture used only to exercise repository plumbing. Its values do not represent observed mortgage loans, Freddie Mac data, agency field names, performance statuses, event codes, or research results.

`agency_event_code` is deliberately set to `NOT_DEFINED` in every row. Event mapping begins only after a specific source release, user guide, and file layout have been approved and documented.
